Hi Elena — really appreciate OrbitAI taking the time. Short answers up top and next steps below: 

1) Gift card delivery: we can do either per-individual e-gift cards (USD) or a single corporate card routed to a nominated company email. We typically issue Amazon or Visa e-gift cards — let me know preference.
2) Charity match: Redwood will issue a charitable donation on our side and provide a PDF receipt on Redwood letterhead; Ops will also email a copy to the finance contact you provide.
3) VAT / shipping: if we ship physical items to an EU address we can provide a commercial invoice and mark shipments as business-to-business. That said, duties/VAT are the recipient’s responsibility unless we set up DDP (we rarely do). If you want Redwood to handle VAT, it will add a processing step and can delay fulfillment by ~7–10 business days.
4) Tax forms / PO: For the gift card we do not generally need a W-9 for the recipient; for the charitable match receipt we need the charity's EIN and mailing address. If your procurement team requires a PO to record the transaction, please share it and we’ll attach it to the record.

I’ve looped in Marissa (advocacy ops) and Grace (finance ops) to handle fulfillment and receipts. Marissa — I put OrbitAI’s ask below; can you confirm the gift card vendor options, attach the CSV template for recipient routing, and confirm timeline if we need to coordinate VAT handling for NL?

Elena — if you can share: 1) gift routing preference (individual v pooled), 2) charity name & EIN, 3) PO number (if required), and 4) shipping/VAT preference (we can default to recipient-handled VAT unless you ask otherwise) — we’ll take it from there.
